legal_full:
Sasin-teny. Manangana sarintany misokatra izahay izay ahafahan'ny olona maneran-tany mizara fandrefesana dosimeter ho an'ny tombontsoa iombonana — siansa, tontolo iainana, fanabeazana ary fiarovana. Amin'ny famoahana ny angonao dia manampy olona maro ianao. Koa mba tandremo ity asa iombonana ity.

1) Andraikitra. Ianao no tompon'andraikitra amin'ny fahamarinan'ny vaovao sy ny votoaty alefanao. Avoaka sy ampiasaina “araka izay misy azy” ny angona. Tsy manamarina na miantoka ny fahamarinana, fahafenoana na fahafahany mifanaraka amin'ny tanjona iray ny tolotra ary tsy tompon'andraikitra amin'ny vokatra mety hitranga amin'ny fampiasana azy.

2) Fahalalahana sy lisansa. Rehefa mizara fandrefesana dosimeter, daty, toerana tombanana, modely fitaovana na zava-misy hafa ianao, dia manaiky fa ho azon'ny rehetra jerena izany ary azo ampiasaina malalaka ny angona amin'ny CC0 1.0 (Public Domain), raha ny kaody kosa mitoetra amin'ny lisansa MIT. Mijanona aminao ny maha-mpamorona; tsy misy tambiny; tsy voafehinay ny fizarana ataon'ny antoko fahatelo.

3) “Araka izay misy azy” ary tsy voamarina mialoha. Miseho tsy misy fanamarinana mialoha ny famoahana. Tsy afaka miantoka ny calibration-n'ny fitaovana na ny tsy fisian'ny hadisoana izahay. Ho an'ny fikarohana ny vaovao fa tsy torohevitra matihanina.

4) Tsiambaratelo sy fanaraha-maso. Mba hitazonana ny sarintany ho azo antoka sy azo itokisana, mety hatao ankapobeny ny timestamp sy coordinates, ary mety hesorina na hatao anonymous ny metadata ara-teknika. Azonay afenina na fafana ny votoaty heverina ho spam, hosoka, tsy ara-dalàna na manelingelina. Tandrina izahay amin'ny fandrefesana marina ary mikendry ny hitahiry azy.

5) Cookies. Mampiasa session cookie ara-teknika fohy ny tranonkala; levona rehefa tapitra ny fitsidihanao. Tsy mitahiry dian-javatra hafa izahay.

Ry namana, vokatr'asa iombonana sy finiavana misokatra ity sarintany ity. Raiso ho toy ny kisary ankapobeny fa tsy planina tena marina. Raha manan-danja aminao ity asa ity dia mankanesa miaraka aminay — afaka manatsara azy isika.

legend_full_en:
📍 How to read a radiation map

The key points from the outset

  • The number shown on the map reflects only part of the radiation hazard — the portion the instrument can detect.
  • Real harm is more often caused not by sudden spikes but by quiet, long-term exposure that builds up over years.
  • Even in a “green” area, risk may still exist due to invisible sources: radon, water, food and air.
  • A map is a guide, not a guarantee. It helps you think but does not replace common sense.
🟩
0–11

Green zone

“Generally safe — but stay attentive”

0–11 microroentgens per hour — close to natural background.

  • you can usually live here permanently
  • drink the water
  • grow and eat local produce
  • this does not mean radiation is absent
  • it means levels are about what the body is used to
  • ⚠ hidden risks still exist: indoor radon; radioactive impurities in water; accumulation of radionuclides in food and tobacco
🟨
11–30

Yellow zone

“Pay attention and find out why”

11–30 microroentgens per hour. Usually no immediate danger, but a yellow patch inside green is a reason to pause.

  • possible causes: radon; alpha or beta contamination the dosimeter only partially sees; localised sources
  • sensible steps: test water and food; identify the source; measure indoor radon
  • harm can build up over time, even if you feel fine now
🟥
30–100

Red zone

“Without checks, it is not worth the risk”

30–100 microroentgens per hour — no longer a normal level.

  • avoid: living here permanently; regularly drinking local water; relying on local food
  • possible causes: man-made radionuclides; contaminated soil; high radon in homes and water
  • recommended: drink water only after testing; eat food after checks; live here only with full awareness of the risks
⬛
100+

Black zone

“Extended exposure is unsafe”

Over 100 microroentgens per hour — a serious level of exposure.

  • risk fronts: external irradiation; radionuclides entering the body; potential skin damage
  • food and water may contain hazardous substances even if they look and smell normal
  • 🔹 exceptions (brief skin exposure): air travel; high-altitude locations

🔍 What a dosimeter shows — and what it misses

Typically detected:

  • gamma radiation
  • sometimes part of beta radiation

Often missed:

  • alpha radiation (especially dangerous once inside the body)
  • radon — a gas we breathe and drink with water
  • tritium in water and air
  • radionuclides in food
  • neutrons (rare, but extremely dangerous)
  • 👉 a “green” reading does not equal full safety.

🧬 How radiation actually enters the body

The most dangerous routes are quiet and long

  • Through breathing — radon, dust, smoke → lungs
  • Through water — tritium and dissolved isotopes → whole body
  • Through food — mushrooms, greens, milk → accumulation in tissues
  • Through smoking — tobacco readily absorbs radionuclides

Less dangerous:

  • brief external exposure
  • one-off contact

⏳ Time is the main risk factor

Radiation is dangerous because of prolonged exposure. Moderate doses taken continuously can be more harmful than a short spike. The body can eliminate radionuclides, but with constant exposure and other stresses those systems get overloaded.

👥 Who is affected more severely

Higher risk for: older people; those with chronic illnesses. What one body tolerates without consequences may cause serious problems for another.

⚛️ Radioactive “disguise”

Some radionuclides resemble ordinary substances to the body: tritium — like water; carbon-14 — like normal carbon; potassium-40 — like potassium; strontium, radium — like calcium. Cells do not recognise the substitution and incorporate them. Damage and mutations are possible even when the dosimeter reads “normal.”

🗺️ Why a map should not be trusted blindly

Even a perfectly green map reflects only part of reality. Hidden factors are not shown. 👉 A map is a hint, not a pardon. You still need to think, check, and ask questions yourself.

legend_full_mg:
📍 Ahoana ny famakiana sarintanin’ny taratra

Ny zava-dehibe tokony ho fantatra hatrany am-piandohana

  • Ny isa eo amin’ny sarintany dia mampiseho ny ampahany amin’ny loza ateraky ny taratra izay azon’ilay fitaovana refesina ihany, fa tsy ny loza rehetra.
  • Matetika ny voka-dratsy ara-pahasalamana dia tsy avy amin’ny fiakarana vetivety, fa avy amin’ny fiharan’ny taratra mangina sy maharitra miangona mandritra ny volana sy taona.
  • Na dia faritra maitso aza dia mety mbola misy loharano miafina, toy ny radon, rano na sakafo voaloto, vovoka ary aerosol.
  • Ny sarintany dia fitaovana fanoroana fa tsy antoka fa azo antoka. Ampiasao miaraka amin’ny fandinihana tsara, fandrefesana manokana ary fitiliana laboratoara raha ilaina.
🟩
0–11

Faritra maitso

Amin’ny ankapobeny akaikin’ny taratra voajanahary — nefa mety mbola hisy loharano hafa

0–11 mikroroentgen isan’ora dia akaikin’ny haavon’ny taratra voajanahary mahazatra.

  • Matetika azo ekena ny fijanonana maharitra amin’ity haavo ity.
  • Matetika azo ampiasaina ny rano sy sakafo eo an-toerana raha tsy misy loharano hafa mandoto.
  • Ny loko maitso tsy midika hoe tsy misy taratra mihitsy; midika fotsiny fa akaikin’ny haavo voajanahary ny taratra ivelany refesina.
  • Mety mbola hisy loza miafina avy amin’ny radon ao an-trano na radionuklida ao anaty rano, sakafo ary paraky.
🟨
11–30

Faritra mavo

Tokony hitandrina sy hitady ny antony

11–30 mikroroentgen isan’ora. Matetika tsy loza tampoka izany, saingy toerana mavo tokana eo afovoan’ny faritra maitso dia tokony hojerena.

  • Mety ho radon, loharano eo an-toerana, na loto alfa/beta izay tsy voarefy manontolo no antony.
  • Raha matetika no iharan’izany dia tsara ny manamarina ny rano fisotro sy ny sakafo.
  • Tadiavo ny loharanon’ny sanda avo ary refeso ny radon ao an-trano.
  • Mety hisy dikany ny fiharan’ny taratra maharitra na dia tsy misy soritr’aretina avy hatrany aza.
🟥
30–100

Faritra mena

Aza manaiky ny loza raha tsy voamarina tsara

30–100 mikroroentgen isan’ora dia tsy tokony heverina ho haavo voajanahary mahazatra intsony.

  • Aza mipetraka maharitra raha tsy mbola fantatra ny antony.
  • Aza mampiasa tsy tapaka rano na sakafo eo an-toerana raha tsy misy fitiliana sahaza.
  • Mety ho radionuklida avy amin’ny asan’olombelona, tany voaloto, na radon avo ao amin’ny trano na rano no antony.
  • Mampiasà rano sy sakafo efa nozahana ary diniho miaraka ny loharano sy ny faharetan’ny fiharan’ny taratra.
⬛
100+

Faritra mainty

Tsy azo antoka ny fijanonana maharitra

Mihoatra ny 100 mikroroentgen isan’ora dia haavon’ny taratra lehibe tokony horaisina am-pahamatorana.

  • Ny loza dia mety avy amin’ny taratra ivelany sy radionuklida miditra ao amin’ny vatana.
  • Ny rano sy sakafo dia mety misy loto radioaktifa na dia toa sy manitra ara-dalàna aza.
  • Mety hiakatra vetivety ny sanda mandritra ny sidina na amin’ny toerana avo; tsy mitovy amin’ny fiainana maharitra amin’ny toerana voaloto izany.

🔍 Inona no asehon’ny dosimetatra — ary inona no mety tsy ho hitany

Matetika hitany

  • taratra gamma
  • indraindray ampahany amin’ny taratra beta

Matetika tsy hitany na ambany loatra ny tombana

  • taratra alfa, indrindra rehefa miditra ao amin’ny vatana ny akora radioaktifa
  • radon ao amin’ny rivotra an-trano sy rano
  • tritium ao anaty rano sy rivotra
  • radionuklida ao amin’ny sakafo
  • neutron, tsy fahita firy fa mety tena mampidi-doza
  • Noho izany ny sanda maitso tsy midika fiarovana tanteraka.

🧬 Ahoana no idiran’ny akora radioaktifa ao amin’ny vatana

  • Amin’ny fofonaina: radon, vovoka radioaktifa ary setroka dia mety hiditra ao amin’ny havokavoka.
  • Amin’ny rano: tritium sy radionuklida levona dia mety hiparitaka ao amin’ny vatana.
  • Amin’ny sakafo: holatra, anana ravina, ronono ary vokatra hafa dia mety hanangona radionuklida sasany.
  • Amin’ny fifohana sigara: ny paraky dia mety hanangona radionuklida izay avy eo tsofina.

Ny fiharan’ny taratra ivelany vetivety na fifandraisana indray mandeha dia matetika latsaka lanja noho ny fiharan’ny taratra miverimberina na mitohy; miankina foana amin’ny fatra sy radionuklida ny tena loza.

⏳ Ny fotoana dia singa lehibe amin’ny loza

Ny fiarovana amin’ny taratra dia manaraka ny fitsipika ALARA: tazonina ambany araka izay azo tanterahina amin’ny antonony ny fiharan’ny taratra. Ny fiharan’ny taratra antonony miverimberina dia mety hanome fatra mitambatra lehibe kokoa noho ny fiakarana iray vetivety. Ahena ny fotoana tsy ilaina akaikin’ny loharano, ampitomboy ny elanelana ary ampiasao fiarovana mety.

👥 Iza no mety ho mora voa kokoa

Ny taona, fahasalamana, fitondrana vohoka ary toe-javatra manokana dia misy fiantraikany amin’ny fahatsapana. Ny zokiolona sy ny olona manana aretina mitaiza dia mety hanana tahiry ara-batana kely kokoa; ny ankizy sy ny bevohoka koa mila fitandremana manokana. Tsy voatery hitovy amin’ny olona rehetra ny vokatry ny fiharan’ny taratra mitovy.

⚛️ ‘Fiafenan’ny’ radionuklida ao amin’ny vatana

Misy radionuklida sasany izay mitondra tena ara-kimika toy ny akora mahazatra: tritium manaraka ny rano, karbôna-14 ny karbôna, potasioma-40 ny potasioma, ary strontium na radium mety hitovy amin’ny kalsioma. Afaka ampidirin’ny vatana ao amin’ny tavy izy ireo, ka mety hisy taratra anatiny na dia mahazatra aza ny vakin’ny dosimetatra ivelany.

🗺️ Nahoana no tsy tokony hatokisana an-jambany ny sarintany

Na sarintany maitso tanteraka aza dia ampahany amin’ny zava-misy ihany no asehony. Tsy afaka mampiseho radionuklida rehetra na làlan’ny fiharan’ny taratra rehetra izy. Ampiasao ho antony hanamarinana bebe kokoa ny sarintany, fa tsy ho fahazoan-dalana tsy hiraharaha ny fisalasalana: eritrereto, refeso, hamarino ary manontania.
